recentItems.title: Leihlo La Sechaba | Maluti a Phofung
recentItems.description:
As the local elections are fast approaching, on this episode, Leihlo La sechaba get an exclusive sit down interview with Maluti-A-Phofung executive mayor to hear about their challenges and plans of service delivery. We also talk to an SABC researcher who give insights about the municipality and its issues stated by the Auditor General’s report.
